own_solution.law: Constant speed gives zero change in kinetic energy. The mechanical power delivered to the lifted assembly is P = Mgh/t. For the base load, P = 80 × 9.8 × 6 / 10 = 470.4 W. With a currently attached box of mass q, P = (80 + q) × 9.8 × 6 / 10.
assumptions: The stated height is the vertical displacement.
A box strapped onto the load for the current lift moves with it.
Gravity is uniform at the stated value.

notes: All certified answers agree with the governing relations. Currently attached box masses of 7, 12 and 28 kg give 511.56, 540.96 and 635.04 W, respectively. Boxes on the stationary crate or used for an earlier lift only do not affect the current lift. Each listed starting elevation cancels in mg[(q + h) - q]/t.
